source_notice_policy: A whole source file is not a legal document by filename. Preserve an actual leading legal comment as an exact byte-range excerpt, with original file hash, when present; never synthesize attribution or turn a string literal/test fixture into a grant.
permission_text_policy: Standard permission text can accompany a publisher declaration as informational conditions. It is not an independently acquired upstream grant or copyright notice and never closes an absent-original-text/rights guarantee by itself. This applies equally to npm and Rust.
